title: Horned Sorcerer Ritual
description: A horned, elf-like sorcerer with wrinkled skin and ornate robes gestures with both hands in the foreground, casting glowing magic. Behind him, hooded cultists surround a ritual altar piled with candles, scrolls, coins, and a smaller horned figure, all set against a dark, smoky background with floating symbols and embers.
